title: Professional Certificate Course in Keynesian Economics and Monetarism
description: Dive into the dynamic evolution of economic theories and unravel the intricate relationship between Keynesian Economics and Monetarism.
longDescription: Understand that how economic theories have developed over time . Examine the environment in which Keynes created his theories, highlighting the need of countercyclical policies, aggregate demand, and the opposition to laissez-faire methods. Gain a thorough understanding of the Quantity Theory of Money, which posits a direct relationship between the money supply, prices, and economic output. Know how changes in the money supply can affect aggregate demand and supply. Understand the Monetarist interpretation of the Phillips Curve, which casts doubt on the idea of a steady short-term trade-off between unemployment and inflation. Explore the historical context that birthed Keynesian Economics, delving into its core tenets of countercyclical policies, aggregate demand, and its stark departure from laissez-faire doctrines. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: This course provides a comprehensive examination of Keynesian Economics and Monetarism, tracing their historical roots, core concepts, and contemporary relevance. Through a blend of theoretical exploration and real-world case studies, participants will gain insights into the complexities of macroeconomic policy-making, the role of government intervention in stabilizing economies, and the ongoing debate surrounding monetary policy effectiveness.
